summary: UPM (UPM.HE, NASDAQ Helsinki) is a Finland-based forest industry group. This Valuatum equity research report dated 24 July 2026 rates the stock HOLD with a 12-month target price of EUR 21.10 versus a current price of EUR 22.23, implying roughly -5.1% downside.

The call is balanced between a recovery path in Fibres and a valuation that already embeds part of the improvement. Pulp spreads need to recover toward the level required to justify Fibres' EV allocation, while Paso de los Toros reaching full 2.1 million tonne capacity supports the EBITDA growth bridge.

The key constraint is valuation: UPM trades at a premium forward EV/EBITDA multiple versus peers, so the selected fair multiple caps upside despite free cash flow support and portfolio actions around Communication Papers and Plywood.

thesis.title: EBITDA Growth Driven by Capacity Ramp
thesis.text: Group EBITDA is forecast to climb from EUR 1,351 million in 2025 to EUR 1,601 million by 2027, driven by Paso de los Toros reaching full 2.1 million tonne capacity and lifting EBIT margin from 7.8% to 10.2%.

thesis.title: Pulp Spread Recovery Required
thesis.text: Pulp spreads sit near EUR 110 per tonne against the EUR 122 per tonne needed to justify Fibres' EUR 5,340 million EV allocation, so the segment depends on Uruguay volumes and margin recovery.

thesis.title: Premium Multiple Caps Upside
thesis.text: UPM trades at 9.3x 2027E EV/EBITDA versus a peer median of 7.5x. The selected 8.5x fair multiple reflects superior margins but keeps the blended EUR 21.10 target below the spot price.

thesisBreaker: Permanent structural impairment of Finnish wood costs due to loss of Russian timber, or EU regulatory block of the Sappi JV.

faqs.a: Valuatum's 24 July 2026 report rates UPM (UPM.HE) HOLD with a 12-month target price of EUR 21.10 versus a EUR 22.23 current price, implying roughly -5.1% downside.
The 24 July 2026 Valuatum report sets a 12-month fundamental target price of EUR 21.10 for UPM, compared with a current price of EUR 22.23.
UPM has a credible EBITDA recovery bridge from capacity ramp-up and pulp spread recovery, but the current valuation already prices in meaningful improvement and caps the upside.

profile: UPM is a Finland-based forest industry group that converts wood and other renewable raw materials into pulp, paper, energy, and bio-based materials. Its business areas include Fibres, Energy, Adhesive Materials, Specialty Papers, Communication Papers, and Plywood. UPM is currently reshaping its portfolio through a signed joint venture combining Communication Papers with Sappi's European graphic paper business, and a proposed demerger separating Plywood into an independently listed company, WISA Group.
